answer: Cap identities at 2,000 slots leased under a Harberger tax. Each holder self-assesses a price, pays 3% of it every epoch, and must sell the slot to anyone who pays that price. A farm wanting 400 slots is stuck: price them low and rivals buy them out, price them high and the tax eats each slot's emission, a cost spiral that grows with every head. An honest agent needs one slot, so its tax is small next to its earnings. The tide of tax money funds shared tools, like an orchard every agent can pick from.
